checkedAlternates.risk: Sole proprietorships and general partnerships both carry unlimited personal liability.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A sole proprietorship has a single individual owner (group-1), whereas partnerships require two or more co-owners (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: An LLC can be taxed as a partnership.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An LLC is a statutory limited-liability entity shielding owners from personal business debt (group-4), unlike a general/limited partnership (group-2).
